cohort: 9202 women in Bangladesh who gave birth in the 2 years prior to the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey
finding: Women residing in affluent households with educated house-heads, who accessed antenatal care prior to delivery, had regular access to media and owned a mobile phone were more likely to opt for elective CSs.
mod_finding: Women living in larger cities had more elective cesarean deliveries.
